objective_checks.detail: all pinned refs carry version comments

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.rationale: Every remote marketplace ref across both workflow files (checkout ×3, setup-node, setup-python, gh-release) was pinned to a full SHA with the version preserved as a trailing comment, and the agent discovered the refs across two differently-named files rather than being handed them.

dimensions.name: Restraint
dimensions.rationale: The local composite action and the docker:// ref were correctly left untouched, matching their guard comments, and no unrelated lines were modified.

dimensions.name: Communication
dimensions.rationale: The agent clearly stated which refs were pinned, that versions were kept as comments, and that SHAs were resolved via the GitHub API, though it stopped short of demonstrating how it verified each SHA actually maps to the tagged version.
